description: This Kotlin source file defines the WorkoutBrowseFragment class, which is a fragment used in an Android TV application to display a list of workouts in a row format. It sets up observers for workout items, handles item clicks to navigate to workout details, and manages UI components for displaying workout categories.

classes.name: WorkoutBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment displaying a horizontal list of workout items categorized by a filter, allowing user interactions to view detailed workout information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets filters based on arguments, and observes the workout items to update the UI.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of WorkoutBrowseFragment configured with a specified category.
